crossRefs.note: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted…
“Make him drunken; for he magnified himself against Yahweh. Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be in…
“We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of…
I know his wrath,” says Yahweh, “that it is nothing; his boastings have done nothing.
Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahweh.
Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because he burned…
The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says…
Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,”…
Therefore as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon…
This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Yahweh…
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…
“Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing…
Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge…
who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge…
A sword is on the boasters, and they will become fools. A sword is on her mighty men, and they will be dismayed.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.
translations.bsb: We have heard of Moab’s pomposity, his exceeding pride and conceit, his overflowing arrogance. But his boasting is empty.
translations.kjv: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies
translations.asv: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogancy, and his pride, and his wrath; his boastings are nought.
